page.title: Collections
page.subtitle: Log what your branch collected. Each entry can be changed for 7 days after its date, then it locks.
page.headOfficeSubtitle: Collections from every branch, newest first. This view is read-only.
page.caption: Collections
page.emptyHint: Collections you log will appear here with their lock countdown.

week.title: This week
week.noReport: The weekly report opens with your first collection.
week.lockExplainer: Entries can be changed for 7 days after their date. After that they lock and stay as recorded.
week.notAccepting: This branch is not taking new collections right now. Past entries stay visible.

form.title: Log a collection
form.amountHint: In rupees, up to 2 decimals, for example 2500.50
form.dateHint: Today or up to 7 days back
form.purposeHint: Pick a suggestion or type your own
form.noteHint: Who gave it, a receipt number, anything useful.
form.editHint: Only the fields you change are saved. Every change is kept in the history.

lock.locksIn: Locks in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

void.title: Void this collection?
void.body: {amount} stays on the record, marked void with your reason, and no longer counts in the weekly total.
void.reasonHint: At least 3 characters. Whoever reviews the report will see it.

detail.title: Collection
detail.readOnlyNotice: This collection can no longer be changed here.
detail.voidHint: Logged by mistake or twice? Void it. It stays on the record with your reason.

errors.collection_locked: This collection is locked: its 7 days for changes have passed.
errors.report_not_open: This week's report is under review or approved, so its collections can't change.
errors.branch_not_accepting: This branch is not taking new collections right now.
errors.branch_closed: This branch is closed. Its collections are read-only.
errors.invalid_money: Enter an amount above zero with at most 2 decimals, for example 2500.50.
errors.future_date: The date can't be in the future.
errors.outside_lock_window: That date is more than 7 days ago, so it is already locked.
errors.week_change_not_allowed: Keep the date in the same week (Monday to Sunday).
errors.empty_patch: Change at least one field before saving.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
